metadata.description: Slight76 team standards handbooks for developers and AI agents: architecture, engineering, operations, data, and security.

plugins.name: architecture-standards
plugins.description: Solution, frontend, backend, integration, and API architecture standards. Use when designing systems, boundaries, contracts, messaging, or reviewing architecture decisions.

plugins.name: engineering-standards
plugins.description: Source control, code review, testing, implementation, agent development, and adoption standards. Use when writing or reviewing code, tests, branches, or commits.

plugins.name: operations-standards
plugins.description: Delivery pipelines, observability, SLOs, incident response, infrastructure, Fly.io/Docker runtime, and backup/DR standards. Use for CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and runbooks.

plugins.name: data-standards
plugins.description: Database design, naming, Postgres practices, EF Core migrations, persistence, caching, and backup/restore standards. Use when touching schemas, queries, migrations, or caches.

plugins.name: security-standards
plugins.description: Application security, identity, CORS, secrets, threat modeling, supply chain, and dependency/SBOM standards. Use for auth, secrets, security reviews, and CI hardening.
